scope: Independent offline review of retained CPU Release 0.5-ms grad1 coarse/half runs and same-dt retained grad0 controls; this new JSON is the only reviewer-created artifact.

key_links_reverified.scope: Check-to-run and run-to-prepared/program links; both XML/BAT pairs; both Run.out and initial/final BI4 files; all four CSV artifacts; the three bound Python analysis/runner helpers.

preceding_independent_audit_completed_in.method: Read retained JSON/CSV and reread all ten new native frames plus the ten corresponding retained same-dt grad0 frames in memory; no solver or file writing. SHA checks recursively covered the new check/run/prepared records and the adopted old check/run records.
preceding_independent_audit_completed_in.safety_review_method: Reread native data through the retained original inspect() guard and recompute the native summary; the original safety function was reused rather than presented as a separately implemented safety model.

independent_half_screen.interpretation: Both grad0 and grad1 remain failed at the same original 5-Pa screen level. The small reduction is not a passing time-convergence result.

same_dt_grad1_minus_grad0_effects_not_ha.stress_definition: Effective stress minus pore pressure on each diagonal; RMS is over the six saved symmetric components, not a Frobenius norm with doubled shear weights.
same_dt_grad1_minus_grad0_effects_not_ha.interpretation: Enabling the existing stress-rate gradient correction substantially changes the coupled transient. A large option effect and the earlier affine operator improvement do not demonstrate improved theoretical Cryer accuracy.

limitations: Only five saved samples per run over 0.5 ms were audited; connected sample histories cannot establish the complete startup waveform or a temporal peak.
The half-step screen failed without relaxed thresholds. No peak-window, long-run or analytical acceptance is granted.
This stage changed only the existing SoilStressRateGradCorr XML option from 0 to 1; it did not implement a replacement force operator or coupled double-precision pressure scheme.
Normal solver completion and passing per-run finite/elastic/drainage/natural-step guards do not prove temporal accuracy.
The reference grad0 pair is retained failed-screen evidence, not an accepted physical truth.
No new solver, notifier, Git operation or change to any previously bound input, script, receipt or production source was performed by this review.
